what_is_closed: For Rinne's coordinate shift beta={0.1,0.5,0.9}, the registered Core residual map yields a 10-dimensional decaying boundary symbol whose source-basis determinant agrees with Rinne Eq. (122) on the preregistered complex-frequency grid.
The sign map is verified: Rinne's inward-pointing N^x=beta corresponds to local outward-normal shift beta_n=-beta; only u1_minus is incoming and u2_A is outgoing in these cases.

equation_or_mapping.rinne_shift_to_core_normal_shift: beta_Rinne=N^x in the x>0 half-space; with outward normal n=-x, beta_n=shift dot n=-beta_Rinne
equation_or_mapping.decaying_root: lambda_1_minus=(1-beta^2)^-1*(-beta*zeta-sqrt(zeta^2+1-beta^2)); choose sqrt with positive real part for Re(zeta)>0
equation_or_mapping.repository_to_source_map: C_source=T_rows*diag(zeta^-1*I6,I4)*C_residual*T_columns; fixed maps imported unchanged from the zero-shift audit

major_result.units: Frozen local orthonormal geometric units; omega normalized to 1 and zeta=s/omega dimensionless.
major_result.derivation_class: source-matched analytic Fourier-Laplace mode and determinant cross-check; finite numerical sampling
major_result.observable: 10x10 boundary-data symbol determinant, rank, characteristic incidence, and principal-mode residual

open_blockers: Rinne beta<0 requires the additional decaying u2_A modes and twenty extra incoming constraint-curl rows, including the degenerate zeta=-beta generalized mode; that lane is not covered here.

The sample does not independently prove a uniform bound over every beta in (0,1) or the closed half-plane in zeta; it relies on the fixed source correspondence and Rinne's theorem for the specified system.
Variable-coefficient/nonlinear GH evolution, corners, matter boundaries, dimensional observables, and Core curved-parent requirements remain open.
